metadata.case_name: NG MEI YUK v. YIP CHI KIN

source: She was found to have a fractured pelvis.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of lumbar spine or pelvis, unspecified

source: retro-peritoneal and extra-peritoneal haemotoma was found.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of unspecified blood vessel at abdomen, lower back or pelvis level

injuries.description: the socket of the hip having been moved up 1" resulting in apparent leg shortening and pelvic tilt
source: this was caused by the socket of the hip having been moved up 1" and by the Plaintiff favouring her right leg by tilting the right side of the pelvis upwards by another 1".
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the hip or thigh

manifestations.description: complains of pain in the right buttock, hip, low back and thigh
difficulty even climbing onto his couch
her right leg appeared 2" shorter than the other (appeared due to hip socket moved up 1" and pelvic tilt)
loss of 10º of her ability to bend the leg at the hip
loss of 45º in the movements of internal and external rotation of the leg at the hip
serious injury greatly reduces her mobility and her lifestyle
she couldn't walk; spent 5 months in bed; relied on crutches until the summer of 1982; since then has needed a walking stick; the furthest she can now walk is less than a block
expectation of life is reduced by at least a year

losses.description: serious injury greatly reduces her mobility and her lifestyle; the furthest she can now walk is less than a block; relied on crutches and now a walking stick
spent 5 months in bed during which time her son employed an amah to care for her; assistance was needed
expectation of life is reduced by at least a year
